## Build it

- Write a 150-line agent with no framework: a model, three tools, a loop, and a log of every step.
- Turn something you use daily (notes folder, a database, a GitHub repo) into an MCP server and connect it to a desktop client.
- Write 20 tasks with checkable answers and measure your agent's success rate over 3 runs each.
